infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: NoirLens uses the camera only when you raise the phone, to read text from the scene. Frames never leave your device.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: NoirLens uses motion sensors to arm the camera when you raise the phone and to power it down when you lower it.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: NoirLens uses the microphone only while you hold to speak in Conversation. Audio is transcribed on-device.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: NoirLens transcribes speech on-device for two-way conversation.
